skills.name: api-contract-mocker
skills.description: Generates zero-dependency mock handlers and fixtures from API specs. Use when receiving OpenAPI schemas, Swagger JSON, or TypeScript interfaces to mock endpoints.

skills.name: context-diet
skills.description: Compresses source code and file context before passing to LLM reasoning. Use when ingesting files over 100 lines, preparing multi-file prompts, or pruning token bloat.

skills.name: pr-distiller
